result:
`Colour · Schemes` is built and the report is committed as `kit/schemes.md`. The two screenshots are gitignored, so they exist only on this machine.

- **Built:** I made the `Schemes · sample` master and a 1920 `Page · Colour · Schemes` component. The component holds five copies (white, light gray, prime, dark, near-black), and each copy sets only its Text mode. Near-black also overrides the fill with `dark` plus 50% black.
- **Edit once:** I swapped one card on the master (Plain to Feature) and all five copies followed.
- **Weak spots:** I ran the contrast script and wrote the weak spots in words in the file's Notes. The main one is that accent labels on prime are faint, because `accent` in `Prime BG` resolves to the mid-brown `dark`. I left the tokens alone.
- **Quick switching:** the Notes recommend changing the page frame's Text mode (one click) over a `Scheme` variant.

I took the full-page screenshot at 100% but checked it only at 1920, not at the other three widths. I also didn't run the docs smoke-test or review agents, so the page hasn't been through a review.
